name: humantoday
description: Make AI-assisted writing sound human without flattening the writer's voice.

interface.longDescription: HumanToday edits AI-assisted writing without sanding off the person who wrote it. It removes 20+ recognizable patterns: binary contrasts, throat-clearing openers, fake insights, padded verbs, vague attribution, synonym cycling, dramatic fragments, and mic-drop endings. For edits, it runs a bounded goal loop that revises, evaluates, repairs failures, and repeats before returning the draft. Use it to edit a draft, detect patterns without rewriting, or generate deliberately terrible AI copy as satire.
defaultPrompt: Edit this draft with the HumanToday goal loop and preserve my voice: (text)
Detect AI-writing patterns in this text without rewriting it: (text)
